strategy.language: English-first, with Italian place names and concise Italian context where useful
strategy.audience: Dog owners planning walks in the Dolomites and the French Alps
strategy.promise: Dog-friendly trails assessed for terrain, shade, water access and exposure — matched to the dog, not just the distance.
strategy.cadence: Three posts per week for a four-week pilot

profiles.bio: The personalised trail guide for dogs and their humans, so every footprint left on the mountain is a safe one. Rooted in the Italian Dolomites.
Dog-first Alpine trail guidance, assessing terrain, shade, water access and exposure for dogs and their humans.
Read the trail through your dog's paws. Dog-first routes in the Alps.

do: Teach one useful thing per post.
Describe what a dog may experience on the ground.
Use cautious language for safety, health, access and weather claims.
Invite people to adapt the walk to the dog and turn back when needed.
avoid: Calling a trail safe for every dog.
Treating a weather warning as proof of a trail closure.
Inventing facts beyond approved ORMA material.
Generic engagement bait, alarmist hooks or excessive hashtags.
